evidence.excerpt: Introducing Clawvisor, the authorization layer for AI agents. Before today, giving access to your agents was all-or-nothing. Now, you can give your agents access that is scoped to your specific task. If your agent drifts or is compromised, it's blocked. Try it today for free. https://t.co/vkVfTG2tMY
